items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1957-08-04
items.q: I've been in a little, little 2x4 band, like myself, when I first started, and he was playing drum

ctx.x: well, sure, I mean, if you don't keep doing it all,

yes, and, nevertheless, I don't take him, I just, it takes interest into it, no more, you see, because I'm getting old, or young something, some people call them old man, some call them young man, so I don't know what I am, you know, so, I just say, well, so I made different things, I made records with this fellow, they called Joe Nicholas, and, when Joe, they called him for nickname, but I called him, Joe Nicklaus, well, they know him from Joe Nicklaus, but I called him Wooden Joe sometimes too, so we played at…
but who plays it though, Mr. Sire,
